findings.title: Member lookup crosses tenant boundary
findings.detail: Campaign ownership is checked but member IDs are looked up globally, allowing foreign members to be attached.
findings.recommendation: Scope member selection to the current tenant and reject foreign IDs.

findings.title: Route targets missing screen
findings.detail: The legacy-export route references a file absent from the source inventory.
findings.recommendation: Implement the screen or remove the route.

findings.title: Pro checkout requests Business
findings.detail: Both buttons send plan business despite different advertised prices.
findings.recommendation: Send the selected plan and verify checkout mapping.

findings.title: Failed load never leaves spinner
findings.detail: The rejection handler sets error but never clears isLoading, so the error branch is unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Clear loading on failure and provide recovery.

findings.title: Setup inputs discarded
findings.detail: Priority and internal version inputs have no state or submission; Next simply hides them.
findings.recommendation: Persist meaningful setup inputs and remove the internal schema field.

findings.title: Invitations disclose individual results and access tokens
findings.detail: Named individual scores contradict the survey privacy promise; survey hashes expose participant access links.
findings.recommendation: Remove individual results and restrict token handling to authorized delivery.

findings.title: Results unlock below promised privacy threshold
findings.detail: One response exposes an aggregate and export despite the survey promise of at least three.
findings.recommendation: Require three responses and enforce the same threshold server-side.

findings.title: Modal lacks accessible dialog behavior
findings.detail: The open variant has no dialog role, accessible naming or keyboard/focus management; text uses low contrast colors.
findings.recommendation: Implement accessible dialog semantics, focus handling and sufficient contrast.

findings.title: Signature has no freshness limit
findings.detail: Valid signatures remain accepted indefinitely because the timestamp is authenticated but never age checked.
findings.recommendation: Validate numeric timestamp against a bounded tolerance.

findings.title: Failure permanently consumes webhook
findings.detail: Event ID is persisted before processing; a worker failure returns 500 but the retry is acknowledged as duplicate without applying the upgrade.
findings.recommendation: Atomically commit the event and upgrade or maintain retryable processing state.

findings.title: Entitlement update trusts unchecked session fields
findings.detail: Worker defaults tier and seats, accepts arbitrary tier or invalid seat counts, and applies completed sessions without payment status validation.
findings.recommendation: Validate paid entitlement against canonical checkout and price data.

findings.title: Billing email is an ambiguous organization key
findings.detail: The first organization matching an email receives the upgrade without a stable customer or checkout organization binding.
findings.recommendation: Resolve a unique stored customer/session association.

findings.title: Concurrent seat upgrades lose updates
findings.detail: Read-modify-write computes seats from stale values when multiple events overlap.
findings.recommendation: Use atomic increments or locked transaction updates.
